answer: Give every identity skin in the game and sybils starve. Each agent posts stake in jade - scarce, recoverable, slashable - before its work counts, and watchers grade honestly because their own stake rides on the verdict. A raven-like sentinel class then feeds only on divergence: accounts whose outputs match nothing their neighbors verify get pecked first, stake redistributed to the graders. A raid of fresh keys flashes across the ledger like a comet, but since none can post collateral or pass replay, the swarm burns its entire stake in a single pass and buys zero lasting voice.
